name: Kotohiki Moroko
source:
A member of the school newspaper club she's always after a big scoop especially one related to the student council. She'll do whatever she can for a story and often stalks the president with her camera.

She catches a photograph of Chinu kissing Seigo and publishes it in the school newspaper.
